annotations.text:
Home page, plan 0003.
Phone frames are 390x844. The home route IS the landing page: anonymous visitors get the front door, signed in users get their zones.
Top row is the Night theme. Bottom row covers empty, offline and error.

"Luna" in the wordmark is a PLACEHOLDER. The product name is not decided. Nothing in the build encodes it: the name lives in one brand config plus the translation files, so a rename touches no component.

Open question on the artboards: "zone" is the backend's word and means nothing to a first time user. The mock keeps it and explains it in one line under the buttons. Worth deciding whether the UI says zone, group, or household.
